confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from several consistent Helsinki-specific sources, but none is dated to July 2026 and the cocktail figure rests on a small sample. Wine is inferred from the local beer price, not sourced directly. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July high season, not checked against live listings. EUR-to-USD conversion uses an assumed rate of about 1.16 USD per EUR, which was not searched. The RBA observation of 0.6947 for 2026-10-16 was taken from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page, not from a page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed. Food and drink anchors are based on Helsinki price data from Numbeo, Whereandwhen, Mylifeelsewhere, and Expatistan. Wine is set from the beer anchor. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of Helsinki summer hotel and hostel rates.
